config.name: g1-mask-cost-pilot
config.description:
G1 PILOT — the structured-generation energy tax on edge (STATUS.md candidate 1, digest #2 "G1 statement"). First real measurement of what grammar/schema- constrained decoding costs in milliseconds AND Joules on an Apple-Silicon edge SoC, where CPU-side mask construction cannot be hidden behind a long GPU forward pass and CPU/GPU contend for one memory bus.
Model: granite3.1-dense:2b Q4_K_M GGUF, resolved from the Ollama blob store and served by a locally built llama-server (Metal). 20 fixed medical tool-call prompts (experiments/prompts/g1-medical-toolcall-v1.json) x 3 conditions (unconstrained / GBNF grammar from the medical JSON schema / llama-server's native json_schema) x 5 repeats with a fixed seed set = 300 measured runs.
Captures per run: llama.cpp timings (prompt_ms, predicted_ms, per-token ms), wall clock, energy integrated over the generation window via powermetrics, and output validity (parses as JSON / validates against the schema) so Joules-per-VALID-output (G2) is computable.
repeats: 1 because the script runs its own 5 repeats internally — it must own the loop to keep one llama-server and one powermetrics stream alive across the whole matrix, and to rotate condition order against thermal drift.
